title: Burghood
subtitle: Fix your street. Look after your home. Know your neighbors.
voice: Meet Burghood: one app to get your street fixed, look after your home, and stay close to your neighbors, here in Allegheny County.

title: The community map
subtitle: Every reported problem near you, in one place
voice: It starts with the community map. Every pothole, broken streetlight and illegal dump your neighbors have reported, in one place. Filter by type, and see what has already been fixed.

title: Safety first
subtitle: Emergencies go to 911, straight away
voice: Reporting takes under a minute. First, Burghood checks that no one is in danger. Downed power lines, a gas smell, or someone hurt? It points you to 911 straight away.

title: Pin the exact spot
subtitle: Search an address or drag the pin
voice: Drop a pin on the exact spot, or search for an address. Burghood works out which municipality it is in.

title: What it is, and how bad
subtitle: A category, a severity and a short note
voice: Pick what it is and how bad it is, add a photo and a short note, and you are done.

title: Sent to the right office
subtitle: PennDOT, the county, or your city or borough
voice: Then the part people love. Burghood tells you who actually fixes it. A state road goes to PennDOT, a local street to your city or borough, with the phone number and website. Neighbors can add a me too, and your name is never shown.

title: Your society
subtitle: Notices, documents and members for your HOA or condo
voice: Burghood also brings your homeowners association or condo society into the app. Find your society by address, or join with an invite code. Every society is verified before it goes live, and members get notices, documents, the HOA account link, and a member list.

title: Community channels
subtitle: Posts, photos, comments, reactions and mentions
voice: Channels are where neighbors talk: snow updates, lost and found, events. Post photos, comment, react, and mention people. Mute a busy channel, and unread counts keep you up to date.

title: Where is the problem?
subtitle: Street, home, or your society's common areas
voice: When you report a problem, Burghood now asks where it is. On the street goes to the city, exactly as before. In your home, or in your society's common areas, becomes a service request.

title: Find a trusted provider
subtitle: Describe the problem, and Burghood finds the trade
voice: Just describe it. Type kitchen tap leaking, and Burghood knows you need a plumber. Choose a distance from two to twenty five miles. Providers your society recommends come first, then the best rated, with a badge for those who passed a background check. Sponsored listings are clearly marked.

title: Provider profiles
subtitle: Services, area, past work and real reviews
voice: Every provider has a profile with their services, area, photos of past work, and reviews from real jobs, with the provider's replies. Ratings are weighted, so one five star review cannot outrank two hundred great ones.

title: Send a request
subtitle: The right questions for each kind of job
voice: Send a request with a title, details and up to six photos. The form asks what matters for that job: urgency and access for repairs, dates and ages for babysitting, pet size for dog walking. No signal? It saves the request and sends it when you are back online.

title: The provider takes the job
subtitle: Accept or decline, start, then mark it done
voice: The provider gets a notification and can accept or decline. They start the job, then mark it done with a note, photos, or a short video.

title: Confirm it, then review
subtitle: Every step on the timeline
voice: You follow every step on the timeline. If it is fixed, confirm it and leave a star rating. If not, tap Not fixed, and the provider comes back to it. For common areas, your society admin picks the provider.

title: Nothing listed yet?
subtitle: One tap to search Google Maps instead
voice: Searching for something no one lists yet? Burghood offers a one tap search on Google Maps, so you are never stuck.

title: Offer your services
subtitle: Providers sign up right in the app
voice: Service providers sign up right in the app, from the Profile tab, even if they do not live in a society. They choose their services and area, and upload their license, insurance or background check. Those documents are seen only by the Burghood team.

title: Approved, then listed
subtitle: A clear listing fee request with a pay link
voice: The Burghood team reviews every application. Once approved, the provider gets a listing fee request with clear payment instructions and a pay link. As soon as the payment is recorded, their profile goes live.

title: Everything in Activity
subtitle: City reports, requests and jobs side by side
voice: Providers manage their work from the Jobs tab, while residents track their city reports and service requests side by side in Activity.

title: The admin console
bullets: Audit report as CSV or PDF
voice: Behind the scenes, the admin console lets the Burghood team verify societies and providers, record background checks, request and record payments, schedule sponsored listings, and export an audit report for the accountant.

title: Burghood
subtitle: Built for Allegheny County. Accessible, private, and free for residents.
voice: Burghood. Built for Allegheny County, readable at any text size, private by design, and free for residents. Fix your street, look after your home, and know your neighbors.
